# 成唯識論集解

**Dynasty:** 明

**Juans:** 10
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0821

## Contributors
- 通潤 (A001156)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle commentary on [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* by the late-Míng Lotus-Sūtra-and-Yogācāra master [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) (Tōngrùn / Yīyǔ 一雨, 1565–1624). The "*jíjiě*" 集解 ("compiled explanations") title indicates a synthetic commentary drawing together the Tang Cí'ēn tradition (especially Kuījī's [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì*) with Tōngrùn's own elaborations. Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X50n0821).

**Abstract**

[通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) is best known for his Lotus Sūtra commentary [KR6d0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0080) *Fǎhuá jīng dàkuǎn*, but his self-designation as "Master of the Two-Lèngyán [Sūtras]" 二楞主人 indicates that the *Lèngyán jīng* 楞嚴經 (Śūraṃgama-sūtra) was equally important to him — and through that text, he was inevitably engaged with the consciousness-only doctrine of the *Chéng wéishí lùn*. The *jíjiě* is the principal product of this Yogācāra engagement.

The dating bracket adopted (1605–1624) covers Tōngrùn's mature period, between the publication of his earliest Lotus-related commentaries and his death in 1624. The work belongs to the same late-Míng Yogācāra revival as Míngyù's [KR6n0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0043) *súquán* and Wáng Kěntáng's [KR6n0045](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0045) *zhèngyì*, and shares with them the program of restoring Cí'ēn doctrinal study in late-Míng Buddhism.

The *jíjiě* is somewhat more eclectic than the other late-Míng commentaries on T1585: Tōngrùn brings to the *Chéng wéishí lùn* the same broad-ranging late-Míng synthesis that characterises his Lotus-Sūtra and Śūraṃgama work, including significant Tiāntái-doctrinal material that the strictly Cí'ēn commentaries (e.g. Míngyù's) keep at arm's length.
